d: Short, chestnut brown hair with messy texture and long bangs swept to the side. Warm amber, almond-shaped eyes with a gentle expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender, lean build wearing a black button-up blazer over a white collared shirt, matching black slim-fit trousers, and bright red sneakers with white laces and soles. Holding a long, jagged black weapon and carrying a dark blue cylindrical case strapped to the back.
